subject: Re: NorthWorx demo timing — finance hold and exec travel
messages:
From: Amanda Liu <amanda@northworx.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: NorthWorx Procurement <procurement@northworx.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: NorthWorx — scheduled demo Nov 3 (CFO travel / finance hold)

Hi Rafael / Evelyn,

We were due to run a full product demo with our execs and procurement on Nov 3, but the CFO is out of the country Nov 1–6 and finance has put a temporary spend hold while they finish their Q4 reforecast. Procurement also needs to validate our PO timing before they engage.

High level — we still want to evaluate Redwood, but we need to either:
- move the live demo until after Nov 6 (when the spend hold should clear), or
- run a short (15–20m) exec summary this week to keep momentum while procurement finishes paperwork.

Can you confirm availability for either option and whether you can provide a 1-page cost placeholder and a draft SOW for procurement to review?

Thanks,
Amanda Liu
Director, Platform Engineering
NorthWorx
(attachment: internal-briefing-notes.txt)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Liu <amanda@northworx.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthWorx — scheduled demo Nov 3 (CFO travel / finance hold)

Amanda — thanks for the heads up and context. Totally understand the finance gating. Two practical paths from our side:

1) Quick exec summary this Thursday Oct 30 or Friday Oct 31 (15–20m):
   - Focus: high-level cost profile, deployment options (hosted vs dedicated), risk/fallbacks.
   - No deep technical Q&A required; we can hand off a recorded walkthrough for the engineering loop.

2) Move the full demo to the next available window after the spend hold — suggest Tues Nov 9 or Wed Nov 10 (your timezone).

I can prepare a one-page cost placeholder and a draft SOW today for procurement to start the review — will flag the items that typically delay PO (data residency, SLAs, support levels, any custom integrations).

Which is preferable for your team? If you want the exec summary, I can hold a 20m slot and have Marcus join for the deployment/ops Q&A.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198
(attachment: pricing-placeholder-1p.pdf)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Liu <amanda@northworx.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T12:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthWorx — scheduled demo Nov 3 (CFO travel / finance hold)

Amanda — quick note from product/CS side: if you take the short exec slot we can still preserve momentum by:
- running a 20m executive overview (value, unit economics, what to expect in a pilot)
- sharing a 25–30m recorded technical walkthrough and a short Q&A doc for your engineers
- sending the draft SOW + SOW checklist to procurement so they can start redlining while finance completes the reforecast

If you pick Nov 9/10 for the full demo, please let us know any focus areas (security, throughput, integration with your data lake) so we tune the demo. Marcus will hold both dates tentatively and will drop the one you don’t pick.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart | Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
(attachment: demo-roles-and-agenda.md)

From: Amanda Liu <amanda@northworx.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, NorthWorx Procurement <procurement@northworx.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NorthWorx — scheduled demo Nov 3 (CFO travel / finance hold)

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility. Finance confirmed the spend hold will last through Nov 6. Given that, procurement prefers to review the SOW/placeholder first and then book the full walkthrough. Can you:

- Send the draft SOW and the 1-page cost placeholder to procurement (copied).
- Hold Nov 9 10:00–11:00 PT for the full demo (tentative). If procurement completes the PO earlier we may accelerate, but Nov 9 looks safe for now.

Also: CFO flagged he wants the pilot to include a pilot acceptance criteria checklist; procurement asked for expected PO lead time once SOW is agreed.

Amanda Liu
Director, Platform Engineering
NorthWorx
(attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Liu <amanda@northworx.com>, NorthWorx Procurement <procurement@northworx.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NorthWorx — scheduled demo Nov 3 (CFO travel / finance hold)

Amanda / procurement team — locking Nov 9, 10:00–11:00 PT for the full demo (calendar invite to follow). Per your requests I’ve attached:
- demo-deck-v3.pdf (PDF) — high-level + technical appendix
- SOW-draft-northworx.docx (Word) — draft with options for pilot length, acceptance criteria, and estimated PO lead times

Quick notes / next steps:
1) Procurement: the draft SOW includes three pilot acceptance criteria templates (throughput smoke test, redaction/compliance check, and end-to-end latency SLO). If you want a custom checklist for the CFO, we can slot a 20m call with Marcus and our solutions architect to finalize.
2) Timeline: once SOW is mutually agreed, standard PO lead time we see is 2–3 weeks for NorthWorx-sized deals (can be faster with a committed pilot date).
3) Rafael will run the executive portion (first 20m) and Evelyn + Marcus will handle the technical deep dive.

If procurement needs any contract-level redlines before Nov 9, please send them to procurement@redwood.com and I’ll route to legal.

See you on Nov 9 — thanks for coordinating.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
r.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
(attachments: demo-deck-v3.pdf, SOW-draft-northworx.docx)
